text:
Sara P.: quick heads-up — acme marketplace is asking for our SOC 2 report, a vendor-checked pen-summary, and an example artifact bundle. want to align owners and TTLs before i reply to their portal request.
Mike R.: thanks — do we have a precedent for presign duration? their portal prefers short-lived links.
Li Chen: typically 24-72h for external links. but for larger bundles we sometimes do 7d with strict access logs. depends on redaction level.
Olga M.: for SOC2 we can share the cert + bridge letter. full report requires NDA — clarify with acme. pen summary (remediation status + CVSS overview) is ok to share publicly.
Sara P.: ok action: confirm whether ACME will sign our SAAS partner NDA. if not, we need redacted artifacts + 72h presign.
Jamie T.: i can own the artifact bundle creation and redaction. suggest these contents: 1) sanitized config snippets, 2) service architecture diagram (non-prod overlay), 3) pen-summary pdf + remediation timeline, 4) SOC2 cert.
Mike R.: fyi — security asks that any presign links be generated from the marketplace-evidence bucket and audited. example presign cmd we use internally: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/ACME-bundle-2026-03-21.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```
Li Chen: note that --expires-in 604800 = 7d. if we want 72h use 259200. i recommend 72h unless acme signs NDA.
Olga M.: redaction checklist: remove IPs, internal Slack screenshots, full user lists, secrets, and any HSM identifiers. add a redaction stamp in the bundle manifest.
Jamie T.: timeline estimate: i can assemble and scrub within 2 business days once i have final list. needs one security review (Mike) and one compliance signoff (Olga).
Mike R.: i'll do the review — please upload to s3://marketplace-evidence/drafts/acme/ and @Evidence Bot will create audit entry.
Evidence Bot: audit created: evidence_id=ev-20260321-72, uploaded_by=Jamie T., s3_path=s3://marketplace-evidence/drafts/acme/ACME-bundle-2026-03-21.tar.gz
Sara P.: perfect — next steps: 1) me to ask ACME whether they'll sign NDA (reply by EOD), 2) Jamie to prep redacted bundle and upload to drafts, 3) Mike to review, 4) Olga to confirm SOC artifacts shareable. if acme says NDA=yes -> presign TTL = 7d. if NDA=no -> presign TTL = 72h + redaction.
Li Chen: small ops note: if we use 7d presign we should set S3 object lock metadata and lifecycle to expire after 30d to avoid stale artifacts. i'll add a short runbook entry.
Jamie T.: acked. i'll ping here when upload is ready.
Olga M.: also flagging joint announcement: if listing goes live we need to coordinate marketing blurb + security page link. Sara, can you own the announcement checklist?
Sara P.: yes, will draft announcement checklist once compliance items are cleared.
Mike R.: tagging for visibility: @Li Chen, @Olga M., @Jamie T. — i'll block 1 hour for review Thurs.
Sara P.: thanks all. i'll post back after acme responds. :thumbsup:
